passes.description: Ensure keyboard focus can be moved away from all components
passes.help: Keyboard users must be able to navigate away from any focused component

passes.description: Focus appears confined; verify whether the escape path is documented or discoverable
passes.help: Verify that users can escape focus-confined areas via documented keyboard methods

disclaimer.message: 自動テストで検出できるのはWCAG違反の一部です。完全な準拠確認には手動テストが必須です。
disclaimer.messageEn: Automated testing can only detect a subset of WCAG violations. Manual testing is required for full compliance.
